scientific_integrity: Finite group and chain computations are exact integer/rational arithmetic; source novelty is assessed against specified inspected literature and searchable records, not claimed as a formal uniqueness proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the ordinary matching complex of Q3; the rational representation is fully determined, the integral central eigensublattices and index are determined, but no higher-cube family theorem or complete abstract integral G-lattice classification is asserted. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: The nonsplit integral octahedral homology lattice of the three-cube matching complex
